chunks.text: Today we will talk about Botswana.
Botswana is a country in Africa.
Let's learn about it in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you like.
Where is Botswana?
Botswana is a country in Southern Africa.
It has no ocean, so it is a landlocked country.
It is next to South Africa, Namibia, Zimbabwe, and Zambia.
Botswana is not a big country, but it is very beautiful.
It has many wild animals and big open lands.
What is the capital city of Botswana?
The capital city is Gaborone.
It is in the south of the country.
Many people live in Gaborone.
It is a modern city with shops, schools, and offices.
But outside the city there is a lot of nature.
How many people live in Botswana?
About two, six million people live in Botswana.
That is not a lot.
The country is quiet and peaceful.
There are not many big cities.
Most of the land is open and natural.
What language do people speak in Botswana?
The main language is English.
English is used in schools and in the government.
But many people also speak Setswana.
Setswana is a national language.
It is spoken in daily life, in homes, and in the streets.
What is the weather like in Botswana?
Botswana is a dry country.
It does not rain a lot.
There are two main seasons.
The dry season and the rainy season.
The dry season is from May to October.
There is little rain.
The weather is sunny and cool.
The rainy season is from November to April.
There is more rain and it can be hot.
What does Botswana look like?
Botswana has many open lands.
There are savannas, deserts, and wetlands.
The Kalahari Desert is in Botswana.
It is very big and dry.
There is also the Okavango Delta.
It is a very special place.
It has water, green trees, and many animals.
The Okavango Delta is famous around the world.
People come to see it.
What animals live in Botswana?
Botswana is great for animals.
There are many national parks.
You can see elephants, lions, zebras, and giraffes.
You can also see hippos, crocodiles, and leopards.
It is a great place for a safari.
Many tourists come to Botswana to see wild animals.
What do people eat in Botswana?
People in Botswana eat simple and healthy food.
One popular dish is called seswa.
It is made with meat, usually beef or goat.
The meat is cooked slowly and pulled apart.
It is often eaten with a thick porridge called pap.
Pap is made from maize corn flour.
People also eat beans, vegetables, and sorghum porridge.
Tea is a popular drink.
People enjoy it in the morning or with friends.
Let's talk about life in Botswana.
Life is peaceful in many places.
Families are important.
People often live near their families.
Music and dance are part of the culture.
Traditional songs and dances are used in celebrations.
People are friendly and polite.
They say dumella to say hello in Botswana.
Would you like to try?
Say dumella.
That means hello.
Some fun facts about Botswana.
Botswana became an independent country in 1966.
The money in Botswana is called the pula.
Pula means rain in Setswana.
Rain is very special in Botswana because it is so dry.
Botswana is one of the best places in the world to see elephants.
It has more elephants than any other country in Africa.
Diamonds are important in Botswana.
The country is rich in diamonds.
Now you know many things about Botswana.
You know where it is.
You know what people speak.
You know about the animals, the food, the weather, and the land.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I hope you enjoyed learning about Botswana.
My name is Emily.
